data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing an interactive book widget with page flipping animations.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to effortlessly create an animated book widget UI with dynamic content rendering. It features customizable cover, content, size, padding, blur radius, animation curves, and duration.
use_when: You want to create an interactive book opening or page-flipping UI.
You need a custom animated widget for displaying content in a book format.
avoid_when: You need a full-featured e-reader or PDF document reader with text selection and pagination.
You do not require any book-related UI animations.
strengths: Easy to implement with clean widget and builder constructors.
Provides highly customizable parameters for shadow, blur, and animation duration.
weaknesses: Limited to specific book-flipping animations and UI formatting.
Lacks advanced document parsing or text management capabilities.
